newsitem.title: USA: Arrow sees products helping revs, income.
newsitem.headline: Arrow sees products helping revs, income.

text.p: Arrow International Inc said on Wednesday it expected new products would help quicken revenue and net income growth during the fiscal year.

In a statement, the company said: "Although new product revenues were difficult to project given the uncertainties of research work and U.S. Food and Drug Administration marketing approval, it was the company's expectation that new products would contribute to accelerated revenue and net income growth as the fiscal year progresses."

Company officers reviewed the progress of seven major new product programs during the annual shareholders' meeting on Wednesday. They said the company received an approvable letter from the FDA on January 4 for the use of morphine for malignant pain in its Model 3000 implantable infusion pump.
Final approval, following the review of specific labeling, is expected this month.
The company reported earnings of $32.8 million, or $1.41 a share, on revenues of $229.9 million in fiscal 1996. The fiscal year ends August 31.
